description: Normative fact-export-v1 schema for the invocations table. Resolves Finding F9 (I01 bare message_id collision) by qualifying invocation_key and message_key with session identity, and separates call grain from usage_only grain.

call_id_missing_reason.description: Explicit reason when invocation_grain == 'usage_only' and message_key is null.

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Null iff invocation_grain == 'call' (message_key != null); non-null iff invocation_grain == 'usage_only' (message_key == null).
x_justification.why_present: Explains why a usage emission lacked a call/message identifier in I01.

canonical_harness.description: Closed canonical harness vocabulary, including unknown.

x_justification.why_present: Qualifies invocation identity across harnesses and supports per-harness invocation breakdowns.

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Uses 'unknown' when effort is not reported and 'not_applicable' for non-reasoning models; never null.
x_justification.why_present: Supports model configuration divergence (I05) and cost-by-effort analysis in Enterprise.
x_justification.zero_content: Closed effort enum including minimal and xhigh.

invocation_grain.description: I01 grain classification: 'call' for evidenced model calls with a message_key, 'usage_only' for usage rows without a call identifier.

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Required closed enum matching i01_invocations.rs ('I01.distinct_calls' vs 'I01.usage_only').
x_justification.why_present: Prevents usage-only counter rows from inflating distinct model invocation counts (I01).

invocation_key.description: Primary key: 64-character lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256 digest over (org, endpoint_scope, canonical_harness, session_key, message_key_or_seq).

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Required primary key on every row.
x_justification.pseudonymization: The incorporated derivation in tables/README.md is authoritative.
x_justification.why_present: Uniquely identifies each model invocation across the fleet and links usage and tool_calls to their parent turn.
x_justification.zero_content: 64-char hex HMAC digest only (DE-004, F9, F13).

invocation_status.description: Execution outcome status of the model invocation.

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Uses 'pending' while a turn is in flight and 'unknown' when completion is not recorded; replaceable within a generation.
x_justification.why_present: Tracks turn completion and error rates without exporting error message strings (F5).
x_justification.zero_content: Closed enum literal; never raw error messages (DE-004, F5).

message_key.description: Session-qualified 64-character hex HMAC-SHA256 pseudonym of the harness message_id when invocation_grain == 'call'.

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Non-null iff invocation_grain == 'call'; null iff invocation_grain == 'usage_only'.
x_justification.pseudonymization: The incorporated derivation in tables/README.md is authoritative.
x_justification.why_present: Provides the qualified deduplication key for I01.distinct_calls.
x_justification.zero_content: 64-char hex HMAC digest only (DE-004, F9, F13).

model.description: Observed public model token, maximum 128 ASCII characters, or null with explicit status.

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Non-null iff model_status in ['observed', 'inferred_from_session']; null iff model_status == 'unknown' (accompanied by model_unknown_reason).
x_justification.pseudonymization: See incorporated tables/README.md and SNAPSHOT.md; no alternate derivation.
x_justification.why_present: Carries per-invocation model attribution, which may be refined by replacement snapshots within a generation.
x_justification.zero_content: Restricted public model token of 1..128 ASCII characters.

model_status.description: Explicit observability status for model attribution.

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Governs whether model is non-null ('observed', 'inferred_from_session') or null ('unknown').
x_justification.why_present: Tracks model attribution completeness for coverage denominators.

model_unknown_reason.description: Shared explicit reason code when model_status == 'unknown'; null when model is observed or inferred_from_session.

x_justification.why_present: Distinguishes in-flight turns awaiting model attribution from events that omit model names.
Eliminates null ambiguity on invocation timestamps.

occurred_at_us.description: Invocation timestamp in UTC microseconds since Unix epoch when observed.

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Non-null iff occurred_at_status == 'observed'; null iff occurred_at_status == 'not_observable'.
x_justification.why_present: Orders invocations temporally and supports time-window slicing.

pseudonym_key_id.description: Identifier of the customer-held HMAC key used to pseudonymize entity keys in this row.

x_justification.pseudonymization: See incorporated tables/README.md and SNAPSHOT.md; no alternate derivation.
x_justification.why_present: Tracks key lineage for pseudonymized invocation and message keys.

sequence_no.description: Zero-based or positive source sequence order within the session generation.

x_justification.why_present: Preserves deterministic within-session ordering even when timestamps tie or are absent.

session_key.description: Foreign key to sessions.session_key (64-character lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256).

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Required foreign key on every invocation row.
x_justification.pseudonymization: The incorporated derivation in tables/README.md is authoritative.
x_justification.why_present: Qualifies I01 invocations by session (F9) and joins invocations to session metadata and link_id.

signal_source.description: Observation surface that produced the invocation record.

x_justification.why_present: Tracks signal provenance across session logs, hooks, and native OTLP.

source_generation.description: Monotonic ingestion generation number for source_id.

x_justification.why_present: Scopes snapshot replacement for within-generation updates.

source_id.description: Pseudonymized 64-character hex HMAC-SHA256 identifier of the ingestion source.

x_justification.pseudonymization: See incorporated tables/README.md and SNAPSHOT.md; no alternate derivation.
x_justification.why_present: Binds the invocation row to its ingestion source for replacement and coverage accounting.
x_justification.zero_content: Hex HMAC digest; never a file path (DE-004).
